resources.string: Admins sign in with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis…) on top of their normal sign-in. Set it up now.
1. Open your authenticator app and add an account with this key (or tap Open authenticator).\n2. Type the 6-digit code it shows.
No authenticator app found. Install one, then add the key by hand.
Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to use the admin tools in this session.
Two-step verification is on for this account. Admin tools need a code each time you sign in.
Turn off two-step verification? Your admin account will be protected by the normal sign-in only.
That code did not work. Check the code and your phone clock, then try again.
